title: Principal Product Manager - Ads Auction and Measurements (Remote - Canada)
description:
Summary
Yelp connects people with great local businesses. Our platform is powered by a vibrant community contributing reviews and engaging with local businesses daily. We monetize primarily through advertising, helping millions of businesses connect with high-intent consumers. The Ads Auction system sits at the heart of this exchange, determining which ads are shown for every opportunity.
The Ads Marketplace team is responsible for the core engine that drives Yelp 's advertising business. We develop and optimize the sophisticated auction, bidding, and pacing systems that balance advertiser value (ROI), consumer experience, and Yelp 's monetization goals. We work at the intersection of economics, machine learning, and large-scale systems engineering.
As the Principal Product Manager for Ads Auction and Measurement, you will own the product strategy and execution for Yelp 's core ad auction, bidding, pricing, budget pacing mechanisms, and corresponding measurements. This is a highly technical leadership role where you will guide the evolution of algorithms and systems that make real-time decisions maximizing value across multiple stakeholders. You will define how we measure the performance and impact of these complex systems, focusing on both short-term efficiency and long-term impact. You will partner closely with world-class engineering and applied science teams to design, experiment, implement, and iterate on auction dynamics and the metrics that guide our progress.
This opportunity is fully remote and does not require you to be located in any particular area in Canada. We welcome applicants from throughout Canada. We’d love to have you apply, even if you don’t feel you meet every single requirement in this posting. At Yelp , we’re looking for great people, not just those who simply check off all the boxes.
What you'll do:

• Auction Strategy & Roadmap: Define and drive the product roadmap for Yelp 's ads auction, bidding algorithms, pricing mechanisms, and budget pacing systems, ensuring alignment with business objectives and competitive dynamics. Identify key levers for optimization and innovation.

• Algorithm & System Optimization: Partner deeply with Engineering and Data Science to design, develop, and refine the auction-based ad selection system. Translate advertiser goals (ROI, leads, conversions), user experience, and monetization considerations into algorithmic requirements, and prioritize initiatives based on concrete data and expected impact.

• Auction Measurement & Evaluation: Define and own the key metrics framework for evaluating auction health, efficiency, and the business impact. Drive the development of robust measurement for complex trade-offs (e.g., relevance vs. monetization, short-term vs. long-term effects). Design and interpret large-scale A/B tests.

• Independent Data Analysis: Conduct hands-on analysis of large-scale auction and advertising datasets using tools like SQL and Python to uncover optimization opportunities, validate hypotheses, understand performance drivers, and inform product decisions.

• Technical Product Development: Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle for auction-related features and improvements, from ideation and requirements definition through launch and iteration.

• Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as the product leader for the auction domain, collaborating effectively with Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Finance, and other Product teams. Communicate complex technical concepts and trade-offs clearly to diverse audiences.

• Drive Business Impact: Directly influence Yelp 's revenue and advertiser success by improving the efficiency and effectiveness of the core ad marketplace.

What it takes to succeed:

• Experience: 8+ years of technical product management experience, preferably focused on auctions, bidding systems, search ranking, or monetization platforms within the online advertising (AdTech) industry.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Strategic WFM Analyst lives in the Core Workforce Management (WFM) Planning & Operations Strategy team and is responsible for owning centralized forecast, capacity planning, workforce cost optimization, and strategic headcount trade-offs across all lines of business (LOBs). Moving beyond traditional scheduling and intraday monitoring, this role acts as a high-judgment governance function, translating complex demand forecasts into defensible FTE, BPO, and overtime spend strategies, modeling capacity risks, and aligning executive stakeholders across Finance, Product, and Operations. You are exceptionally strong in WFM math and financial analytics, exhibit deep strategic curiosity, navigate messy raw data effortlessly, and communicate recommendations with executive-level clarity.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Translating multi-LOB demand forecasts into monthly and quarterly capacity, headcount, and budget requirements.

- Blank-Page Ownership: High comfort operating in ambiguous environments with incomplete data, verifiably isolating what materially matters without requiring step-by-step direction.

- WFM Analyst Profile: Strong core WFM domain expertise with a strategic/Ops spike, not a generalist and not a passive traditional scheduler.

Remote
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify 's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading - PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites - into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting - Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.
Overview
Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.
This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own - that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.
We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.
What You'll Do

• Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team - from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight

• Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features

• Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval

• Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

• Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

• Keep the shared pieces in working order - tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

• Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own

• Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out

• When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time

• Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out

• Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear

• Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

• Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

• Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team

• Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.
An Ideal Candidate Should Have

• 5+ years of software engineering experien

title: Marketing Ops Manager
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a marketing operations manager to run how our marketing ships and how we measure it, for two brands: Darkroom, our growth marketing agency, and Shadow, our AI commerce platform. Ad Age recently described us as "if Omnicom was rebuilt on AI." We publish across LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube and a weekly podcast, and every piece has to go out on time, look right and be tracked.

This is the role that makes a busy content team reliable. You take what the team has approved and get it live on the right channel at the right time, answer the people who respond, keep our CRM clean, and show us what all of it produced. You don't plan content or write briefs; you make sure the plan happens and that we can see the result.

This is a remote role, hiring in Brazil, Portugal or Spain only, working with a team in the EST Time Zone, and all business is conducted 100% in English.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- Publishing: Every approved piece scheduled and published across our channels for both brands: LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, X and YouTube. Adapt posts for each platform and ship routine announcements.

- Podcast: Publish every episode to podcast platforms and YouTube, and get its clips out across our channels.

- Launches: A run-of-show for every launch: what goes live where and when, sequenced across accounts, embargoes respected, everything checked live.

- Community Management: Comments, DMs and mentions across our channels, answered quickly and in our voice. Sensitive questions escalated; recurring themes passed back to the team.

- Awards & Competitions: The awards calendar: deadlines, materials and entries, so our best work gets entered and recognized.

- Production Tracking & QA: One intake for requests, a delivery schedule everyone can see, and a final check of copy, assets, links and tracking before anything goes live.

- HubSpot Hygiene: Clean data, accurate lead sources and UTMs, deduplication and working workflows.

- Inbound Dashboard: One trusted view of inbound leads by source, channel and content, so we know what is working.

- Reporting: Weekly and monthly marketing reports that explain what moved and why.

- Systems: Our scheduling, project and asset tools kept organized, and repeatable steps automated with AI.

YOU SHOULD APPLY IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU

- 3+ years as a hands-on marketing operations generalist: publishing, production tracking and reporting.

- You have administered HubSpot: properties, workflows, deduplication, lead source and UTM tracking, dashboards.

- You know each social platform well and can answer a comment or DM in a brand's voice.

- You have a sharp QA eye. The wrong link, tag or claim never ships on your watch.

- You build dashboards people trust and can explain what moved and why.

- You are calm under volume and keep many dates moving at once without dropping one.

- You already work with Claude, ChatGPT, or similar daily and use them to automate real work.

HARD DISQUALIFIERS

- No hands-on HubSpot or CRM admin experience.

- Never owned a publishing calendar across several channels.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace-we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Наш партнер - продуктова IT-компанія, яка розвиває міжнародний онлайн-сервіс у сфері особистого розвитку. Він поєднує практичний контент та інтерактивні інструменти, що допомагають користувачам краще розуміти себе, формувати нові звички та застосовувати отримані знання в повсякденному житті.

Зараз шукаємо Head of Engineering, який допоможе команді розвивати продукт, ухвалювати сильні технічні рішення та впевнено проходити наступні етапи зростання.

Тут буде простір розібратися, запропонувати своє й побачити, як твоя ідея працює на практиці. А ще - люди, з якими можна відкрито обговорювати складні питання, сперечатися про рішення та разом знаходити кращий шлях.

Чим ти займатимешся:

• Формуватимеш технічне бачення продукту та план його розвитку разом із командою й бізнесом.

• Очолиш engineering-команду: 3 backend-а, 3 frontend-а, 2 mobile devs, один DevOps та 2 QA.

• Допомагатимеш інженерам розвиватися, брати відповідальність і працювати злагоджено.

• Покращуватимеш архітектуру, якість коду та підходи до розробки, тестування й релізів.

• Працюватимеш із продуктивністю, надійністю та масштабуванням сервісів.

• Узгоджуватимеш технічні й продуктові пріоритети: де варто інвестувати в покращення зараз, а де достатньо простішого рішення.

• Знаходитимеш можливості зробити роботу команди зрозумілішою, швидшою та комфортнішою.

Із чим працюватимеш:

Основний backend-стек - PHP, Laravel та MySQL. На frontend - TypeScript та Vue.

У технічному середовищі також є API, внутрішні інструменти, аналітичні сховища, автоматизації та контейнеризована інфраструктура з CI/CD. Більше про архітектуру, команду та актуальні виклики розповімо на знайомстві.

Нам буде цікаво познайомитися, якщо ти:

• Маєш 4+ роки комерційного досвіду backend-розробки, зокрема на PHP, та 2+ роки роботи з Laravel.

• Маєш 2+ роки управлінського досвіду та керував технічною командою від 5 людей.

• Вмієш будувати й розвивати процеси, які допомагають команді доставляти результат.

• Працював із базами даних, чергами повідомлень, кешуванням і пошуковими системами.

• Маєш досвід із мікросервісною архітектурою та оптимізацією сервісів під навантаженням.

• Можеш зануритися в технічні деталі й пояснити рішення людині без інженерного бекграунду.

• Почуваєшся комфортно у продуктовому середовищі, де потрібно експериментувати, визначати пріоритети та адаптуватися до змін.

Володієш англійською на рівні Pre-Intermediate або вище.

Нам близький керівник, до якого можна прийти зі складним питанням, невдалою спробою або сміливою ідеєю. Людина, яка вміє слухати, давати чесний фідбек і допомагати команді знаходити рішення.

Що отримаєш:

• Можливість впливати на продукт, технічну стратегію та розвиток команди.

• Простір для ініціативи: пропонувати зміни, перевіряти підходи й реалізовувати власні ідеї.

• Відкриту комунікацію з командою та стейкхолдерами.

• Гібридний формат роботи в Києві.

• Оплачувану відпустку та лікарняні.

• Підтримку професійного навчання.

• Необхідну техніку для роботи.

• Добровільне медичне страхування після випробувального терміну

Якщо тобі цікаво будувати сильну engineering-команду й розвивати продукт, на який ти справді можеш впливати, - будемо раді познайомитися 🙂

description:
Our Why At Dotmatics 

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company,  we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform - best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics 

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation.  Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together. 

What do we need 

We are looking for an experienced market leader, thought leader and SME in CMC Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls) .
CMC leaders carry a lot. They own the science and the decisions behind how a drug gets made, from late stage development through launch and across the full product lifecycle. They sit between Pharmaceutical Sciences, supply and quality organizations, manufacturing sites, and regulators. Their data lives in too many places, and their teams spend too much time chasing it.

We’re building Luma, a Scientific Intelligence Platform for life sciences and materials science. CMC is a core part of our Molecule to Market story. We need someone to own the market strategy for it.

This is a customer and market facing role. You’ll spend real time with CMC leaders at pharma, biotech, and CDMOs, hearing what they need and bringing it back to the business. You’ll also support teams around the world across Siemens, including sales, product, services, customer success, and the Siemens Solution Marketing team, so everyone can speak to the CMC market with confidence and one consistent story. You’ll work with industry thought leaders to shape the conversation on digital and AI in CMC. Your job is to drive software adoption and AI use cases across CMC. You will shape where we play, who we sell to, how we position, and how we win. 

How you’ll spend your time

• Customer engagements: meeting CMC leaders, joining pursuits, and bringing what you hear back to the business

• Sales enablement: giving the field the talk tracks, battlecards, demo narratives, and proof points to win

• Market analysis: sizing segments, tracking competitors, and spotting trends early

• Marketing enablement: shaping the content, campaigns, and events that reach the CMC audience

• Cross-organization alignment: working across Siemens DISW and DI Automation teams so we show up as one company with one story for the CMC market

The goal is simple. Drive excellence in how we represent ourselves to CMC buyers.

description:
Venez rejoindre l'IMT Mines Alès, grande école de prestige qui se classe parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs sur le plan national et mondial et implantée à Alès, ville à taille humaine, capitale des Cévennes où la qualité de vie est fortement appréciée par ses habitants.
Créée en 1843, IMT Mines Alès compte à ce jour 1400 élèves (dont 250 étrangers) et 380 personnels. L’école dispose de 3 centres de recherche et d’enseignement de haut niveau scientifique et technologique, qui œuvrent dans les domaines des matériaux et du génie civil (C2MA), de l’environnement et des risques (CREER), de l’intelligence artificielle et du génie industriel et numérique (CERIS). Elle dispose de 12 plateformes technologiques et compte 1600 entreprises partenaires. Pour en savoir plus : https://www.imt-mines-ales.fr

Vous êtes rattaché(e) au Centre de Recherche et d’Enseignement en Environnement et Risques (CREER) de l'IMT Mines Alès et dans l'unité de recherche : HSM.

Ce travail s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet AMI CMA 3MRBAT qui porte sur l’évaluation environnementale de différents scénarios du cycle de vie des batteries lithium-ion, avec pour objectif de mieux comprendre les principaux « hot spot » des batteries.

Vos missions :

• Vous vous appuierez sur l’expertise des partenaires de 3MRBAT, et sur les données techniques des principaux projets industriels qui sont en débat Public au niveau de la France et sur la littérature scientifique existante. Un soin particulier sera apporté au niveau de l’impact sur les ressources en eau, l’ensemble des activités de cette filière nécessitant de grands volumes d’eau.

• Vous contribuerez au développement des enseignements d'IMT Mines Alès dans le cadre du Mastère Spécialisé PRINEC.

• Vous participerez à la conception et à la mise en place d'un module de formation interactif sur le cycle de vie des batteries, afin de mettre en évidence l’influence des différents scénarios d’approvisionnement, de fabrication, d’utilisation et de fin de vie sur les impacts environnementaux. Vous préparerez les supports pédagogiques et assurerez les enseignements associés.

• Vous participerez à la valorisation scientifique des travaux réalisés dans le cadre du projet.

• Vous serez encouragée à diffuser les résultats de vos recherches au travers de publications dans des revues scientifiques internationales, de communications lors de congrès nationaux et internationaux, ainsi que de présentations auprès des partenaires du projet.

Wayve’s Robot Software team builds the onboard software used by our development fleet to enable autonomous driving and collect the data needed to train new driving models. title: Product Designer, Growth
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. Our product teams work across research, engineering, product, data, and design to bring OpenAI’s technology to people and businesses around the world.

Design plays a critical role in making powerful AI intuitive, useful, and trustworthy. We hold a high bar for quality and build experiences that earn users’ confidence, while moving quickly and learning from real-world feedback. We favor early validation and continuous refinement over waiting until every detail is perfect.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Designer to shape how startups, small businesses, and growing teams discover, adopt, and unlock lasting value from ChatGPT. You’ll own growth experiences across the customer journey, turning the potential of AI into meaningful, everyday impact for people across the world.

This is a highly hands-on role for a designer who pairs exceptional craft with strong product judgment and an experimental mindset. You’ll tackle some of our most interesting growth challenges, using creativity, product intuition, and experimentation to discover new opportunities. We’re looking for someone who loves treating metrics as puzzles to solve, finding unexpected solutions, and learning quickly through iteration.

Above all, you bring exceptional design craft and believe that driving measurable impact and building beautiful, intuitive experiences should go hand in hand.

This role is based in our San Francisco HQ. We offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

- Own end-to-end design for growth experiences across ChatGPT

- Design and improve experiences across user lifecycle stages like discovery, onboarding, activation, engagement, collaboration, conversion, and retention.

- Turn ambiguous opportunities into clear hypotheses, compelling prototypes, and polished product experiences.

- Set a high bar for interaction design, visual craft, systems thinking, content, and end-to-end coherence.

- Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, research, and go-to-market teams to shape both strategy and execution.

- Use quantitative data, experimentation, research, and qualitative insights to identify opportunities and evaluate outcomes.

- Translate complex and rapidly evolving AI capabilities into approachable experiences for people with a wide range of technical expertise.

- Move fluidly between longer-term product vision and fast, iterative execution.

- Contribute reusable patterns and insights that strengthen growth experiences across ChatGPT.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have a portfolio demonstrating exceptional product thinking, interaction design, and visual craft across complex, shipped products.

- Have led substantial product initiatives from early exploration through launch and iteration.

- Possess strong product judgment and can connect user needs, business goals, technical possibilities, and measurable outcomes.

- Are comfortable working with data and experiments while balancing quantitative signals with research, intuition, and design judgment.

- Can move quickly without compromising clarity, coherence, trust, or craft.

- Are fluent in using AI to explore, prototype, communicate, and extend what you can build.

- Can turn ambiguous, fast-moving problems into a clear point of view and actionable product direction.

- Communicate through strong narratives and prototypes that align cross-functional teams.

- Are excited to rethink established growth patterns and invent interactions that feel native to AI.

- Care deeply about building products that are useful, trustworthy, and worthy of users’ time.

Direct experience in growth design or developer products is helpful but not required. We’re most interested in designers with strong product judgment, exceptional craft, and evidence that their work meaningfully changed user behavior or business outcomes.

title: Meridial – Associate Scientist – In Vivo Neuroscience
description:
About Meridial
 
Meridial is a Focused Research Organisation (FRO) with a mission to bring connectomics into the living brain. We are building a platform for longitudinal, synapse-resolution mapping of functional neural circuitry in preclinical models. Our aim is to deploy this platform for translational projects and improve drug development outcomes for disorders of the central nervous system. 
 
Meridial is a new not-for-profit FRO in the Convergent Research Ecosystem and funded by the Advanced Research and Invention Agency (ARIA).
 
About the role
Meridial is seeking an experimental neuroscientist to join our team as Associate Scientist - In Vivo Neuroscience.
This is a hands-on role. You will carry out neurosurgery, longitudinal two-photon imaging and optogenetic experiments in mice as part of Meridial’s programme to develop advanced 3D imaging and photostimulation technologies for functional mapping of neural circuits.
We are looking for a scientist with strong practical and experimental skills. You should already have substantial hands-on experience with mouse neurosurgery and in vivo two-photon imaging and be motivated to develop these skills further.
You will join a small Experimental Team that will grow over the coming year, and will be able to contribute to the development of protocols and workflows from an early stage. You will report to the Director of Experimental Research and will receive hands-on training and mentoring from more senior scientists in the team. You will also work closely with engineers and computational researchers across Meridial.

title: Senior Software Engineer — Storage Platform 🖥️⚙️ REMOTE
description:
Company Overview:
Our client is a publicly traded cloud storage company with two flagship products: a personal computer backup solution and a cloud object storage platform often compared to Amazon S3 - but chosen for its pricing and a no-egress-fees policy that has made it a go-to for cost-conscious builders. They run their own physical data centers (4 in the U.S., plus Netherlands and Canada), and their engineering culture is unusually transparent - they publish deep technical blog posts and hardware reliability reports that the industry actually reads. They're expanding globally, with active hiring across LATAM, India, and the Philippines. This isn't a company that abstracts away the hard parts; they own the stack, and it shows.
Your Role:
The Storage Platform team owns the foundational durable storage layer that every product is built on top of. Their job - and yours - is to make sure data doesn't get lost, performance holds at scale, and the architecture is ready for the next decade of growth. This is an open-ended, ambiguous, systems-close-to-the-metal role: you'll be investigating unclear symptoms, optimizing for specific hardware behaviors, improving throughput, and helping redesign components that general-purpose tools can no longer handle well. You'll be fully embedded with the U.S. team - not a satellite - which means deep collaboration, clear communication, and real ownership.
You'll:

• Build and evolve a storage platform operating at cloud scale - we're talking exabyte-level storage with real durability constraints

• Optimize for different hard drive and hardware characteristics, improving throughput and reducing error rates across hardware failure modes

• Troubleshoot ambiguous, symptom-driven problems where the signal is limited and the root cause isn't obvious

• Contribute to major architectural upgrades that will support the platform for the next 5-10 years - including support for emerging storage technologies

• Take ownership of parts of the stack where general-purpose components stop being the right fit

• Improve hardware utilization and efficiency as the business grows upmarket and scale increases

• Collaborate closely with a distributed team - coordinating, problem-solving, and communicating across time zones daily

You Bring:

• Strong software engineering fundamentals with comfort operating lower in the stack

• Experience with complex systems where performance, reliability, and cost actually matter

• A genuine ability to work through ambiguity - you can navigate limited signal and multiple possible causes without getting stuck

• Solid collaboration and communication skills in English (strong enough for deep technical conversations)

• Proficiency in Java , or meaningful experience in adjacent languages (C, C++, C#, Rust ) - fundamentals matter more than the specific language

• A track record of shipping in environments where engineering decisions have real downstream consequences

Bonus points:

• Experience working with hardware or systems tightly coupled to hardware behavior

• Exposure to Rust or interest in growing into it

• Breadth across different systems and types of projects over time

What They Offer:

• Fully remote contractor role based in LATAM (currently focused on Costa Rica, Mexico, Chile, and Colombia)

• Competitive USD compensation: $50K-$90K base (location/market-adjusted) plus ~10% bonus

• Full integration with the U.S. engineering team - real ownership, not a satellite setup

• A chance to work on infrastructure that underpins real customer data at meaningful scale

• A company with an unusually transparent engineering culture and a strong technical reputation

Interview Process:
1️⃣ Recruiter Screen - behavioral alignment, comp, logistics, and a few targeted questions
2️⃣ Technical Phone Screen - with a lead engineer from the Storage Platform team
3️⃣ Panel Interviews (×3) - ranging from lower-level coding to higher-level system design topics

title: Freelance Data Engineer (Postgres / Systemintegration)
description:
über juni

JUNI ist ein gemeinnütziges Ökosystem für Wissenschaft und Ausgründungen in Berlin. Wir betreiben unsere Programme über sieben SaaS-Tools hinweg - Newsletter, Events, Community, CRM, Formulare, Bewerbungen, Coworking - und darunter eine Postgres-Datenbank, die der eine Ort sein soll, an dem eine Person existiert.
Auf die Datenbank kommt es an. Ein aufgelöster Datensatz pro Person und pro Organisation, eine append-only-Zeile pro Interaktion, und ein deterministischer Weg zu entscheiden, zu welcher Person ein eingehender Payload gehört. Ziel ist, den Weg vom ersten Kontaktpunkt bis zum Meilenstein messbar zu machen. Die Verbindungsschicht zwischen den Tools und dieser Datenbank ist die Aufgabe.

deine aufgaben

Die Schicht bauen, die unsere Systeme mit einer Datenbank verbindet - in beide Richtungen - und uns dabei helfen, das Datenmodell richtig hinzubekommen.
Die Form der Daten steht weitgehend, und jedes neue System stellt sie auf die Probe. Quellen sind sich nicht einig, was als eine Person zählt, wann etwas passiert ist, und ob sie es zweimal melden. Das zu klären - und zu erkennen, wann das Modell angepasst werden muss, statt es um eine Quelle herumzubiegen - ist der Kern der Arbeit.
Wir suchen jemanden, der das mit uns durchdenkt und für einen bestimmten Entwurf argumentiert, nicht nur umsetzt, was spezifiziert ist.

dein profil

Umfang

Inbound Jedes System in die Datenbank. Mehrere Pipelines pro System - Quellen melden sehr unterschiedliche Dinge. Identitätsauflösung über Systeme hinweg. Outbound Manche Zustände entstehen bei uns, nicht im Tool. Die Datenbank entscheidet und schiebt an die Plattform, die es ausführt. Beide Richtungen sauber halten Plattformen melden zurück und widersprechen uns manchmal. Wer sich abgemeldet hat, darf nicht wieder hinzugefügt werden. Reporting KPI-Daten müssen in einem BI-Tool ankommen. Sie dorthin zu bringen gehört dazu, Dashboards bauen nicht. Suche Den Datenbestand in natürlicher Sprache durchsuchbar machen. Dokumentation Entscheidungen schriftlich, Pipelines in GitHub.
Nicht Teil der Rolle

• Frontend. Es gibt keins und es ist keins geplant.
Voraussetzungen

•
Integration gegen Third-Party-APIs und Webhooks , in der Tiefe: Pagination, Retries, Signaturprüfung, Rate Limits, undokumentierte Payload-Strukturen, verspätete und vertauschte Events, Quellen, die bei jeder Änderung feuern und nicht sagen, was sich geändert hat.

•
Bidirektionale Synchronisation zwischen Systemen, die beide dasselbe Feld für ihres halten - Loop-Vermeidung, Echo-Unterdrückung, eine klare Antwort darauf, wer bei Konflikten gewinnt.

•
Postgres als Anwendungsdatenbank, nicht nur als Ziel. plpgsql-Funktionen, Trigger, Constraints und RLS, um Regeln beim Schreiben durchzusetzen. Wenn sich deine SQL-Erfahrung auf Transformationen nach dem Load beschränkt, passt die Rolle nicht.

• Idempotenz als Gewohnheit, nicht als Nachgedanke. Eine Pipeline, die erneut läuft und nichts verändert, ist der Abnahmetest.

• Sauberes Arbeiten mit Git - Migrationen, PRs, Review.

• Arbeit mit personenbezogenen Daten unter der DSGVO, und ein Verständnis dafür, warum das einschränkt, was überhaupt eingelesen wird.

• Englisch in Schrift. Die Arbeit läuft überwiegend asynchron, und was du baust, muss für jemanden lesbar sein, der nicht dabei war.

Hilfreich, nicht erforderlich
n8n oder ein anderer Orchestrator · Supabase · Relevanzarbeit an einem Suchindex - Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Meilisearch oder vergleichbar; Cluster-Betrieb ist nicht der Teil, den wir brauchen · Erfahrung als einzige Person auf einem System · Deutsch.

wir bieten

Zusammenarbeit
Remote und überwiegend asynchron, aber nicht wortlos - gerade am Anfang sind echte Gespräche eingeplant, während du dich in die Systeme und ihre Zusammenhänge einarbeitest.
Rahmen
Freiberuflich, Start so bald wie möglich. Zunächst drei Monate; danach sehen wir, was gebraucht wird.
Berlin oder Remote innerhalb der EU.

title: Senior Linux Kernel Driver Engineer
description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.   The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. The Role This role sits at the boundary between host and silicon. The kernel driver is key to keeping pace with our ultra-fast devices on cutting-edge server platforms. It’s a high-leverage layer where each win shows up as real throughput and latency gains. You’ll be there for the pre-silicon simulations, first bring-up, first end-to-end runs, and the moments where performance jumps because of something you shipped. What you’ll do Design, develop, and maintain the Linux kernel driver for Fractile’s AI accelerator

title: Senior Workplace Technician
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are seeking a proactive, highly adaptable Senior Workplace Technician to be the full-time, on-site anchor (Mon-Fri) of our office campus. You are a natural self-starter who brings a warm approachable energy, a customer-first mindset and a sharp eye for the details that make a workplace feel exceptional.
Beyond your technical and practical know-how, your greatest strength lies in taking complete ownership-stepping up in grey areas, adapting to quick pivots, and executing high-impact solutions with ease.

GENERAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

In this role, you will keep our daily office environment running smoothly by taking ownership of a diverse set of workplace and operational functions, including:

- Lead physical office modifications, move/add/change (MAC) activities, furniture assemblies, and spatial reconfigurations.

- Skilled in both digital workplace platforms (Google Workspace, Slack, ticketing systems, space planning apps) and practical, hands-on physical execution like furniture assembly, basic repairs, and everyday maintenance.

- Oversee campus EV charging stations by monitoring usage, troubleshooting technical issues on the spot, and partnering directly with vendors for hardware or software resolutions.

- Operational Optimization: Stay three steps ahead by spotting bottlenecks early and bringing fresh, creative ideas to make our physical facilities run smarter and more efficiently.

- Builds strong in-person relationships with cross-functional partners and team members to plan, coordinate, and deliver exceptional everyday workplace services.

- Resolve facilities tickets efficiently and with care, keeping communication transparent and ensuring every workplace request is handled to the highest standard.

- Manage project budgets efficiently: monitoring spend, driving cost-effective vendor solutions, and maintaining tight fiscal responsibility across all on-site initiatives.

- Vendor Management: Manage on-site third-party vendors and contractors, ensuring service partners consistently meet standards of accountability and performance quality.

WHO YOU ARE

- Experience: You’ve spent 5+ years in facility operations, managing multi-floor spaces or large corporate campuses where things move fast. If you have trade certifications (IFMA, BOC, LEED AP, or similar), that's definitely a big plus in our book.

- Ownership & Initiative: Drive project results from conception to completion with minimal supervision, keeping key stakeholders updated every step of the way.

- Self-Starter Energy: You don't wait for a manual. You love taking ownership, solving unstructured problems, and getting things done.

- Customer-Obsessed: You care deeply about people, bring great energy to every interaction, and take pride in crafting spaces people love working in.

- Adaptable & Resilient: You thrive in fast-paced environments, ride the waves of change effortlessly, and stay cool under pressure.

- Soft Skills: Excellent problem-solving skills, strong verbal and written communication, and a customer-service mindset.

- On-Your-Feet Readiness: Ready to move, lift up to 50 lbs, assemble or configure setups, and jump in to support occasional cool workplace events.

- In-Office Dedication: Thrilled to be on-site 5 days a week, acting as the anchor

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Harvey's Enterprise Sales Manager, India will be the founding sales leader in the market, responsible for establishing and scaling Harvey's enterprise go-to-market motion across India. This role will build and coach a team of high-performing Account Executives driving the growth of Harvey's AI solutions within the legal and professional services markets in the country. As the first sales manager on the ground in India, this person will define the local playbook, develop relationships with leading law firms, corporate legal departments, and professional services organizations, and serve as a key member of Harvey's APAC founding team. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who can navigate ambiguity, operate in a fast-paced environment, and build from scratch with limited oversight - combining the mindset of a player-coach with the strategic vision to scale. This is a rare opportunity to shape Harvey's presence in one of the world's largest and fastest-growing legal markets from the ground up.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Establish Harvey's enterprise sales presence in India, building the foundation for a high-performing regional team.

- Recruit, mentor, and lead a team of consultative, solution-based Enterprise sales professionals as the market grows.

- Own long-term strategy and day-to-day operations of the India sales team, including pipeline development, forecasting, and revenue targets.

- Develop and adapt Harvey's sales playbook for the Indian market, documenting learnings that can be applied across APAC.

- Work cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Legal Engineering, and Customer Success to build effective processes and solutions for clients in India.

- Cultivate relationships with Indian law firms, in-house legal teams at large enterprises and global capability centers (GCCs), and professional services organizations.

WHAT YOU HAVE

- 10+ years of tech sales experience and 5+ years of people management experience.

- Experience building or scaling Enterprise sales teams in India, APAC, or other emerging markets, ideally within SaaS or legal technology.

- Proven track record of selling complex software solutions to enterprise clients using a consultative, value-based selling methodology.

- Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to a variety of audiences, including senior legal professionals and law firm partners.

- Demonstrated passion for AI and its potential applications in knowledge work, with interest in the legal profession and helping lawyers work more effectively.

- Energized by ambiguity, early-stage environments, and building foundational processes from the ground up.

Developer Productivity · AI Coding Agents · Developer Platform

Our ambition: an engineering organisation where humans and agents work as one continuously learning system, turning frontier AI capabilities and real-world feedback into more ambitious product development. title: Buyer
description:
Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place!

E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems.

We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life.

About the Role 
We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Buyer to join our growing procurement team. This role is critical in supporting the transition of components and printed circuit boards (PCBs) from development into full-scale production for aerospace applications. You’ll work closely with engineering, quality, planning, and supply chain teams to ensure supplier readiness, cost efficiency, and compliance with industry standards.

This is a full time, exempt position, based out of either our Saratoga, CA or Arlington, TX office.  The target base pay for this position is $100,000 - $200,000 annually.  The total compensation packaged will be determined by various factors such as your relevant job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.  We are redefining how satellites are designed, manufactured and used-so we’re looking for candidates with passion, deep knowledge and direct experience on LEO satellite component development, design and in-orbit activities. If that’s your experience - then we’ll be immediately wow-ed. E-Space is not currently able to provide employment sponsorship for candidates who do not hold work authorization for the location of this role. 

Why E-Space is right for you:

As a member of our team, you will play a crucial role in driving our success.  Our team members have a strong sense of dedication and responsibility; this includes a strong commitment to our mission to create an entirely new suite of global capabilities to improve lives, business efficiencies and build a smarter planet. This means that there will be times when extra hours, including nights and weekends, may be needed to meet critical deadlines and mission goals.  In return, we offer a dynamic work environment with opportunities for professional growth and development and the chance to make a meaningful impact in a high-growth industry.  

We want you to make the most of your journey at E-Space. That’s why we support and invest in the physical, emotional and financial well-being of our team members and their families. Some of what you can expect when working at E-Space:

• An opportunity to really make a difference
• Sustainability at our core
• Fair and honest workplace
• Innovative thinking is encouraged
• Competitive salaries
• Continuous learning and development
• Health and wellness care options
• Financial solutions for the future
• Optional legal services (US only)
• Paid holidays
• Paid time off

title: HR Coordinator (Part Time, Remote)
description:
We’re not just behavioral health people-we’re crisis people.

Connections Health Solutions is a leading provider of immediate-access behavioral health crisis care. Our team combines medical and recovery-oriented treatment to stabilize individuals in crisis and connect them to community-based resources for ongoing recovery.
Founded by emergency room psychiatrists Dr. Chris Carson and Dr. Robert Williamson, our model is physician-led and data-driven, drawing upon more than 15 years of crisis care expertise. Recognized by SAMHSA and the National Council for Mental Wellbeing as a national best practice, we’ve delivered invaluable treatment to hundreds of thousands of individuals facing crises. Our commitment remains consistent, to improve access, inspire hope, and provide the right support.
Our values shape our decisions, define our culture, and foster continuous learning and growth.
We accept people as they are, creating safe spaces where they feel valued and respected. We inspire hope by walking with people side-by-side, showing them grace and compassion. We act with intention, holding ourselves and each other accountable, and doing the right thing. We work as one team, trusting and supporting each other. Benefits, Leaves, & Workers Compensation Support

• Provides administrative support to the Benefits Administrator for benefits, leaves, and workers’ compensation activities

• Provide backup coverage to the Benefit Administrator during peak periods, absences, or as workload requires

• Assist with answering basic questions and escalates as appropriate for timely follow up

• Assist with annual benefits activities and other benefit-related initiatives

Compliance Records & Support

• Partners with HR Business Partners (HRBPs) to proactively review employee files and records for completeness and compliance

• Partners with center HR to assist with any records audit related to a regulatory visit

• Maintains confidentiality regarding all employee records.

• Follows up with requests for information from government, licensing or regulatory entities such as unemployment claims, and validation of worked hours
People Projects & Initiatives

• Provides administrative and coordination support for seasonal and special People projects under the direction of HR leadersh

title: Senior Tax Accountant
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

Vinted’s Finance team is in charge of producing transparent, high-quality financial accounts, as well as contributing towards sustainable operations and company growth. To keep up with the rapid advancement and increasing complexity of our financial operations, the finance department is looking for a new member.

We are looking for a Senior Tax accountant, who will be responsible for tax compliance of our companies in Poland, UK, Netherlands, Germany, Lithuania, France, Spain, Luxembourg, US, Canada and Australia. You will join our Accounting Tax team, work closely with other Finance teams, and contribute to our shared success through accurate and timely tax reporting.

In this position, you’ll 

• Run the monthly and quarterly VAT/GST and US Sales Tax cycle for our foreign companies: coordinate the data requests, review and manage returns submissions and payments/refunds

• Prepare VAT returns, VAT invoice registers for our Lithuanian companies

• Manage corporate income tax (CIT) installments and review the CIT returns prepared by external consultants

• Own the VAT/GST, CIT and US Sales Tax balance sheet accounts on our GL: month-close procedures, journal entries and account reconciliations, using NetSuite and FloQast

• Be the first contact for direct and indirect tax questions and explain tax rules to accounting and other teams

• Run complex reconciliations and tax checks to identify and resolve errors, differences and risks

• Handle tax audit requests and other tax inquiries together with other internal teams

• Lead cross-team tax projects

About you 

• Degree in accounting or equivalent

• Experience in accounting and tax

• Good knowledge of tax treatment according to tax laws (VAT, corporate income tax), including more complex cases

• Knowledge of EU VAT (Advantage: US sales tax)

• Proficient user of MS Excel (Advantage: Experienced user of Claude)

• Experience with NetSuite or similar accounting software would be considered as advantage

• Attention to detail and a problem-solving mindset

• Curious about working in a dynamic environment

• Excellent at communicating in spoken and written English

Work perks

• 25 working days of holiday

• Access to all the tools & tech needed for work

• Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
